description: This file implements the USBDeviceImplementation class, which manages USB device detection, information retrieval, driver binding/unbinding, and event dispatching using libusb. It handles device hotplug events, device enumeration, and descriptor parsing, serving as a core component for USB device management within the project.

classes.name: USBDeviceImplementation
classes.description: Main class managing USB device detection, information retrieval, driver binding/unbinding, and event dispatching using libusb. Implements hotplug callbacks, device enumeration, and descriptor parsing.

methods.name: libUSBInit
methods.description: Initializes libusb context, registers hotplug callbacks, and starts event handling thread.

methods.name: libUSBClose
methods.description: Cleans up libusb context, deregisters callbacks, and stops event handling thread.

methods.name: libUSBEventsHandlingThread
methods.description: Thread function that handles libusb events in a loop.

methods.name: libUSBHotPlugCallbackDeviceAttached
methods.description: Callback invoked when a USB device is attached; retrieves device info and dispatches event.

methods.name: libUSBHotPlugCallbackDeviceDetached
methods.description: Callback invoked when a USB device is detached; retrieves device info and dispatches event.

methods.name: getDeviceSerialNumber
methods.description: Retrieves the serial number of a USB device via sysfs.

methods.name: getDevicePathFromDevice
methods.description: Determines the device path for a USB device by matching serial number and vendor/model info.

methods.name: getUSBDescriptorValue
methods.description: Retrieves a string descriptor from a device handle given a language ID and descriptor index.

methods.name: getUSBExtInfoStructFromDeviceDescriptor
methods.description: Retrieves extended device info, including manufacturer, product, serial number, and language IDs.

methods.name: getUSBDeviceInfoStructFromDeviceDescriptor
methods.description: Populates a USBDeviceInfo structure with details from a libusb device descriptor.

methods.name: getUSBDevicClassFromInterfaceDescriptor
methods.description: Determines device class and subclass from interface descriptors.

methods.name: getUSBDeviceStructFromDeviceDescriptor
methods.description: Fills a USBDevice structure with basic device info from libusb device descriptor.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a notification callback for USB device events.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Unregisters a notification callback.

methods.name: dispatchEvent
methods.description: Dispatches a USB device event to registered notifications.

methods.name: Dispatch
methods.description: Invokes callback methods on registered notifications based on event type.

methods.name: GetDeviceList
methods.description: Enumerates connected USB devices and returns a list of device info.

methods.name: GetDeviceInfo
methods.description: Retrieves detailed info for a specific device by device name.

methods.name: BindDriver
methods.description: Binds a driver to a specified USB device.

methods.name: UnbindDriver
methods.description: Unbinds a driver from a specified USB device.
